description: Source code for a Lua table manipulation library, implementing functions like insert, remove, move, sort, pack, and unpack for Lua tables.

methods.name: checkfield
methods.description: Checks if a specific field exists in a table's metatable, used for verifying table-like behavior.

methods.name: checktab
methods.description: Verifies that a Lua argument is a table or behaves like one with necessary metamethods.

methods.name: tinsert
methods.description: Inserts an element into a Lua table at a specified position or at the end.

methods.name: tremove
methods.description: Removes and returns an element from a Lua table at a specified position or the last element.

methods.name: tmove
methods.description: Copies a range of elements from one part of a table to another, possibly to a different table.

methods.name: addfield
methods.description: Adds a string element from a table to a buffer for concatenation.

methods.name: tconcat
methods.description: Concatenates table elements into a string with a separator.

methods.name: tpack
methods.description: Packs multiple values into a table with a count.

methods.name: tunpack
methods.description: Unpacks table elements into multiple return values.

methods.name: sort
methods.description: Sorts a Lua table using quicksort algorithm with optional custom comparison function.

methods.name: luaopen_table
methods.description: Initializes the table library in Lua, registering functions like insert, remove, sort, etc.
